stem: In the debate over the ratification of the U.S. Constitution, which point would have been made by a Federalist?

options.label: A
options.text: “The existing national government lacks the ability to add new states to the union.”

options.label: B
options.text: “The states are in danger of losing the ability to raise revenue.”

options.label: C
options.text: “The existing national government lacks the power to perform essential functions.”

options.label: D
options.text: “The states are unable to protect the rights of the people.”
